caption: The drawing features a decorative motif with a combination of detailed and sketch-like elements. Above this design, there is uppercase text in gray that reads "E NORTON & CO / BENNINGTON VT" followed by a large numeral "4." Below the floral motif, to the right, there is a simple outline of a jar or crock in blue, showing two side handles and an upper lip. LOUGHRIDGE," is written in small capitals at the bottom center of the paper. The overall composition uses primarily blue and gray on a cream paper background.
